name: el-trueque.com
description:
TRUEQ is the token of El Trueque (el-trueque.com), multi-chain launchpad and marketplace for digital creators. 50% of El Trueque's fees are used to buy back and burn TRUEQ. Supply of 1,000,000 TRUEQ, 40,000 burned at launch: 80% in vesting for user rewards (nothing released for 3 months, then 24 months linear), 15% in a single-sided SOL pool on Meteora with liquidity locked forever, 4% burned and 1% airdropped to El Trueque NFT holders.
